articles.title: UK court ruling boosts government’s chances of keeping $5 billion in seized bitcoin
articles.snippet: The decision concerns 61,000 BTC seized by the Metropolitan Police in its investigation into Zhimin Qian, who pleaded guilty to defrauding thousands of people in China.

articles.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
articles.snippet: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000, decoupling from tumbling Korean stocks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

articles.title: SWI raises $894 million to repurpose former FTX bitcoin miner Genesis Digital to AI
articles.snippet: SWI Group said it would use the proceeds from an 800 million-euro ($894 million) fundraise to transform Genesis Digital Assets, acquired from the FTX bankruptcy, from a bitcoin miner to an AI-focused data center.

articles.title: Most tokenized stock trading on Solana, BNB Chain occurs outside US market hours
articles.snippet: Tokenized equities have reached nearly $3.3 billion in value as investors embrace round-the-clock access beyond Wall Street hours.
